common.error_generic: Something went wrong. Try again in a moment.

landing.hero_title_2: We give it back to you as a mirror.
landing.hero_subtitle: You write for a while about how you move through the world. Umbra returns a written portrait and a personal plan, anchored in serious psychology. Not therapy, not a test, not a label.
landing.how_title: From your words to a written portrait
landing.how_step_1_desc: We ask questions, you reply in your own words. No multiple choice. What you write is just you telling us something.
landing.how_step_2_title: An in-house model reads between the lines
landing.how_step_2_desc: Your text passes through an AI module trained to recognise patterns of the Big Five personality traits. Each dimension is reported on its own and honestly when one does not reach minimum confidence.
landing.how_step_3_title: A warm portrait, not a diagnosis
landing.how_step_3_desc: A long narrative written in Argentine voseo, an interpretive reading of how you think, and a personal plan with checkable micro-actions.
landing.pillars_title: What we want you to know
landing.pillar_rigor_desc: What the system infers automatically is one psychological model: Big Five (openness, conscientiousness, extraversion, agreeableness, neuroticism). Nothing else. The rest is reading, not measurement.
landing.pillar_jung_desc: Jung's cognitive functions (1921) are an interpretive reading, not a closed typology. You will not leave with INTJ stuck on your forehead. We do not use MBTI.
landing.pillar_pc_desc: No engagement notifications, no scoring against others. The idea is that you come in, it serves you, and you come back when you want. Inspired by Positive Computing (Calvo and Peters, 2014).
landing.pillar_ar_desc: Voseo, local idioms, warm and non-clinical register. If it addresses you formally, something broke.
landing.trust_law: We comply with Argentine Law 25.326. Your consent is blocking and traceable.
landing.trust_export: You can download everything we have about you whenever you want.
landing.trust_delete: If you ask to be deleted, we send you a single-use link. You confirm. Everything goes.
landing.trust_research: Academic research only if you opt in. You can opt out at any time.
landing.closing_desc: Ten minutes writing. What you receive is for you.
landing.footer_not_therapy: Umbra is not therapy. If you are in crisis: 135 (CABA y GBA), 911, or 0800-999-0091 (national mental health emergency support, 24 hours).

auth.register_subtitle: We need an email so we can save your profile when you finish. Nothing else.
auth.login_subtitle: Sign in to return to your portrait and plan.
auth.field_name_hint: How you want us to call you when we speak to you.
auth.field_email_hint: We use it to log you back in and to send the deletion link if you ever ask for it.
auth.field_password_hint: Minimum 8 characters. Mix letters, numbers and a symbol.
auth.invalid_credentials: Email or password don't match. Try again.
auth.email_exists: There's already an account with that email. Want to sign in?
auth.weak_password: We need a password of 8 characters or more.
auth.email_not_confirmed: Your email isn't confirmed yet. Look for the link we sent (also check spam) and open it to activate your account.
auth.check_email: We sent a confirmation link to your email. Open it and come back here to continue.

consent.title: Your data, your rules
consent.subtitle: In Argentina, Law 25.326 says we can only process your data if you accept it explicitly and understanding what we do. Here's the plain version.
consent.section_data_intro: While you use Umbra, we store only what's needed to give you back your profile:
consent.section_data_email: Your email and a name to greet you.
consent.section_data_text: The text you write during onboarding and chat.
consent.section_data_profile: The profile the system builds with that (Big Five scores, Jung functions reading, orienting archetype).
consent.section_data_consent: The date you accepted these terms and a hash of the text you are reading now, so we can prove tomorrow what you signed today.
consent.section_who_intro: Three places, none with your identity attached to the text:
consent.section_who_supabase: Supabase (PostgreSQL in Brazil) stores data with per-user access policies. Only you can read yours.
consent.section_who_anthropic: Anthropic only receives your text to write your narrative. It does not store it beyond processing.
consent.section_who_ml: Our in-house machine learning module infers Big Five scores without storing your text.
consent.section_rights_export: Download all your data as JSON from Settings.
consent.section_rights_delete: Request total deletion. We send a single-use link, you confirm, and everything cascades away.
consent.section_rights_optout: Withdraw research consent if you accepted it. Reversible.
consent.accept_label: I understand what I read and accept that Umbra processes my data this way. I know this is not therapy and I can return to this same decision in Settings.
consent.research_label: I also allow my pseudonymized data to be used for academic research by Umbra. Optional and removable any time.
consent.learn_more: I want to see the full text

onboarding.selector_title: How would you like to enter?
onboarding.selector_subtitle: Two ways to do the same thing. Pick the one that feels easier.
onboarding.selector_chat_desc: I'll ask you 4 to 8 adaptive questions. You answer in your own words. About 10 minutes.
onboarding.selector_chatgpt_desc: If you've already chatted with ChatGPT or another assistant and want to use that as a starting point, paste it and we begin from there.
onboarding.title: Let's talk
onboarding.subtitle: No rush
onboarding.intro: Reply naturally, like telling someone who's listening. As you go, your profile builds itself on the side. You can stop whenever and come back another time.
onboarding.disclaimer_text: It's a self-knowledge tool. If at some point you feel you need more, call 135 (CABA y GBA) or 0800-999-0091 (national mental health emergency support, 24 hours).
onboarding.synthesis: Bringing together what you told me…
onboarding.live_panel_empty: Nothing to show yet. Answer the first question and discoveries appear.
onboarding.crisis_redirect: We notice things in what you're writing that worry us. Do this with someone better suited than a website. 135 (Argentina) or 0800-999-0091.
onboarding.rate_limited: We've reached today's limit. Come back tomorrow and we'll continue where we left off.

dashboard.tagline: Your portrait, on a single page
dashboard.archetype_help: A symbolic figure that organises your narrative. Not a diagnosis, an interpretive reading.
dashboard.narrative_help: Written by Claude (external generative AI provider) over your Big Five profile. In Argentine voseo, no clinical labels.
dashboard.radar_help: The five dimensions of the Big Five model (also called OCEAN). Each bar is one of your general inclinations on a 0-100 scale. Not percentiles, not diagnoses.
dashboard.jung_help: An interpretive reading inspired by the eight cognitive functions Jung described in 1921. We use it as a mirror, not a closed typology.
dashboard.carta_locked: Your letter to your future self opens on {date}
dashboard.preliminar_help: This dimension didn't reach the module's minimum confidence (R²>0.20 and r>0.30). We show it grey so you take it with margin.
dashboard.low_confidence_note: Some dimensions appear as preliminary. The more text you write in future sessions, the sharper they get.
dashboard.openness_help: How drawn you are to ideas, art, weird questions. High = open. Low = preferring the familiar.
dashboard.conscientiousness_help: How much you plan, organise and sustain goals. High = disciplined. Low = flexible and spontaneous.
dashboard.extraversion_help: Whether you recharge with people or alone. High = extraverted. Low = introverted (not shyness).
dashboard.agreeableness_help: Your willingness to collaborate and trust. High = more conciliatory. Low = more confrontational or critical.
dashboard.neuroticism_help: How much things shake you. High is not pathology. Low = more stable. High = you feel everything keenly.
dashboard.function_se_help: Extraverted Sensing: the body's here-and-now, present-moment pleasure.
dashboard.function_si_help: Introverted Sensing: detailed memory, what's familiar and known.
dashboard.function_ne_help: Extraverted Intuition: exploring new possibilities, connecting scattered ideas.
dashboard.function_ni_help: Introverted Intuition: inner vision that seems to know before explaining.
dashboard.function_te_help: Extraverted Thinking: organising the world with clear, effective logic.
dashboard.function_ti_help: Introverted Thinking: understanding deep principles, assembling frameworks.
dashboard.function_fe_help: Extraverted Feeling: reading the group's emotional climate and harmonising it.
dashboard.function_fi_help: Introverted Feeling: compass of personal values, what truly matters to you.

crisis_card.body: Umbra is not therapy and I don't want you to go through this moment alone with a website. Speak to someone trained to be with you now.

plan.title: Paths to explore
plan.subtitle: Three areas of growth, designed from your profile. Small checkable steps. No deadlines push you — you set the pace.
plan.completion_hint: Tick what you're doing. It saves itself.

export.title: Take your profile with you
export.subtitle: A printable PDF with your written portrait, the five-dimension scores, the cognitive functions reading, the archetype and the development plan.

settings.title: Settings
settings.subtitle: Your data, your participation in research, and your account. Everything here is so you stay in control.
settings.export_data_desc: A JSON with everything we have about you. Fulfils your right of access under Law 25.326.
settings.delete_account_desc: Erases your profile, narrative, conversations, plan and research data. Right of cancellation under Law 25.326.
settings.research_opt_desc: Turn on/off pseudonymized contribution to the academic research dataset.
